L1.scope: the reference side (Amendment 4 items 2 and 3); L1 is decided by comparing Node and Chromium with these digests
L1.record: normalised text as UTF-8 hex ('-' when empty) TAB pieces 'id,start,end,hex' separated by single spaces ('-' when none), as traces/wordpiece_v1.txt; per-instance SHA-256 over the record's UTF-8; list digest = SHA-256 of the hex lines, LF after each (the cache file)
L1.id_stream: Amendment 1 item 2: per instance LEB128(number of ids) then LEB128 of each id, instances in order

hugging_face.settings: BertWordPieceTokenizer(vocab file, lowercase=True, strip_accents=True, clean_text=True, handle_chinese_chars=True), encode(add_special_tokens=False); an instance differs when its token strings differ from ours

a.source: every WordNet 3.0 gloss field, (part of speech, offset) order

b.source: every '# text = ' sentence of UD English EWT train, dev, test (4a4d77f)

c.source: the Unicode stress set (spike S6, bd1179ea...)

d.source: 2,000 synthetic strings, string i from Rng(1000 + i)

1.what: S6's R(s) = drop Mn(NFD(lower(s))) from the pinned table, per case (lexicon.phase2.table_r): the reference side Node and Chromium compare the platform's toLowerCase().normalize('NFD') minus \p{Mn} against; decided there (must differ on >= 1 case)

2.what: WordPiece shortest-match-first against the registered longest-match-first; an instance differs when its record differs (must differ on >= 1 instance of a)

3.what: N_B without accent stripping (lowercase kept, NFD and Mn removal skipped) against the registered pipeline; an instance differs when its record differs (must differ on >= 1 instance of a or b)
